app.name: Open Skies
f.exo.no_damage.tip: Exosuit and starship ignore incoming damage.
f.exo.hazard.tip: Heat, cold, toxic and radiation shielding stay full.
f.exo.life_support.tip: Life support and hazard protection stay full.
f.exo.marine_jetpack.tip: Jetpack fuel never drains while swimming.
f.move.jetpack_power.tip: Stronger lift, steering and top speed.
f.mt.instant_mining.tip: Resources break in one hit. Creatures take normal damage.
f.mt.beam_heat.tip: Beam weapons never overheat or drain charge.
f.mt.one_shot.tip: Creatures and drones go down in one hit.
f.mt.boltcaster.tip: Every clip-fed Multi-Tool weapon keeps a full clip.
f.mt.javelin.tip: The Blaze Javelin fires fully charged.
f.mt.neutron.tip: Neutron Cannon ammo and charge never drain.
f.mt.scan_instant.tip: The Analysis Visor identifies targets instantly.
f.mt.scan_look.tip: Anything under the visor is scanned without holding the key.
f.mt.topo_scanner.tip: Scanner pulses are ready again at once.
f.ship.tech_charge.tip: Shields, pulse fuel, launch fuel, ammo and grenades stay full.
f.ship.engine_speed.tip: Scales thrust, boost and top speed.
f.vehicle.weapons.tip: Exocraft lasers, cannons and flamethrowers use no charge.
f.craft.free.tip: Crafting takes nothing from your inventory.
f.craft.always.tip: Recipes, repairs and installs count as affordable.
f.refiner.free.tip: Refining does not use up the input.
f.inv.no_overload.tip: Install any number of upgrades of the same type.
f.inv.last_moved.tip: Move a stack in your inventory, then edit its amount here.
f.inv.max_stacks.tip: Exosuit and ship stacks stay at their limit.
f.eco.units.tip: Open your inventory once to read the wallet.
f.eco.nanites.tip: Open your inventory once to read the wallet.
f.eco.quicksilver.tip: Open your inventory once to read the wallet.
f.eco.gek.tip: Standing with this group. Rank updates when set.
f.eco.vykeen.tip: Standing with this group. Rank updates when set.
f.eco.korvax.tip: Standing with this group. Rank updates when set.
f.eco.merchants.tip: Standing with this group. Rank updates when set.
f.eco.mercenaries.tip: Standing with this group. Rank updates when set.
f.eco.explorers.tip: Standing with this group. Rank updates when set.
f.eco.outlaws.tip: Standing with this group. Rank updates when set.
f.eco.local.tip: Standing with the race living in the current system, in this system only.
f.world.portal.tip: Portals know every glyph and skip entry.
f.world.time.tip: Holds the sun at a set hour.
f.world.weather.tip: Every planet in this system gets the weather you pick. Turn it off to get the real weather back.
f.world.storm_force.tip: Storms come as often as the game allows. Turn off Disable Storms for this to work.
f.world.speed.tip: Slows down or speeds up the game clock.
f.tp.fly.tip: Fly on foot. WASD moves, Space rises, Ctrl sinks, Shift is faster.
ui.planned.note: Research in progress. Shown so you can see where it will live.
ui.unavailable.note: Not found in this game version.
info.toggle.click: Click the switch on the row.
info.nokey: None yet. Set one on the Hotkeys page.
info.set.desc: Type a value and press Enter, or use the quick buttons.
tabdesc.exosuit: Survival systems, sprinting and jetpack behaviour.
tabdesc.starship: Ship systems, weapons and flight speed.
tabdesc.exocraft: Fuel and boost for every exocraft, including the Nautilon.
tabdesc.economy: Units, nanites, quicksilver and standing with every race and guild.
tabdesc.world: Interaction speed, time of day and weather.
tabdesc.teleport: Save spots and jump back to them.
tabdesc.tuner: Game values as multipliers, a few per group.
tabdesc.hotkeys: Bind any feature to a key. Click a key box, then press the new key.
tabdesc.settings: Menu, saving, logging and language options.
hk.title: Hotkeys
hk.note: Click a key to rebind it. Esc cancels, Backspace clears.
set.open_menu.tip: The key that shows and hides Open Skies.
set.language.tip: Packs go in the Locales folder next to the game.
set.layout.tip: Folding sections or one long list.
set.accent.tip: Highlight color used across the menu.
set.tooltips.tip: Show a short description for the hovered option.
set.block.tip: The game ignores mouse and keys while the menu is open.
set.skip_logos.tip: Skips the logo movies when the game starts.
set.window.tip: Moves the menu back to the center.
set.remember.tip: Re-enable your features on the next launch.
set.diag.tip: Logs game build, hook targets and feature state.
set.folder.tip: Opens the folder with the log and settings.
browser.sort.name: Name
items.ingame: Load a save to browse items.
f.exo.health.tip: Damage never lowers your health. Healing still works.
f.exo.shield.tip: Hits leave the exosuit shield untouched.
f.exo.no_break.tip: Hits no longer damage installed technology.
f.mt.charge.tip: Charged weapons like the Neutron Cannon fire at full charge.
f.mt.free_reload.tip: Reloads and grenade shots use no ammo or charge.
f.ship.no_heat.tip: All starship weapons stay cool, rockets included.
f.ship.shield.tip: Hits leave the starship shield untouched.
f.ship.hull.tip: Damage never lowers starship hull. Repairs still work.
f.fleet.no_damage.tip: Failed expedition events no longer damage frigates.
f.inv.tech_charge.tip: Suit, ship, Multi-Tool and exocraft tech stay full.
f.inv.tech_repair.tip: Damaged technology is repaired as soon as it breaks.
f.inv.free_fuel.tip: Sets the game's own Fuel Usage option to Free while on.
tabdesc.unlocks: Learn blueprints, words, glyphs, titles and rewards. Pick items to see what changes.
unl.subtitle: Select items in the grid
unl.help: Click to preview, click again to select. Known items show a check.
unl.note: Titles and expedition rewards are account wide. Your save is backed up before the first change.
tabdesc.garage: Change your current starship and Multi-Tool live. Revert puts the original back.
gar.note.ship: The ship rebuilds in place after each change. Class changes also roll base stats and supercharged slots.
gar.note.tool: The Multi-Tool rebuilds in your hands after each change.
tabdesc.expeditions: Replay past expeditions offline and unlock their rewards.
exp.subtitle: Past expeditions
exp.help: Put season JSON files in {0}. Then pick an expedition, arm it, and choose Expedition on the game's mode select page.
exp.next: Open Play and pick Expedition in an empty slot.
exp.note: Start expeditions in an empty save slot. Rewards are account wide. Your save is backed up before the first change.
f.tune.jet_refill.tip: Refill rate on the ground and in the air.
f.tune.space.tip: Space speed and thrust for every ship type.
f.tune.ship_recharge.tip: Boost and launch thrusters refill faster.
f.tune.vehicle_fuel.tip: Driving and boosting use less fuel.
f.tune.storm_freq.tip: How often storms come and how long they last.
tp.subtitle: Saved locations
tp.help: Save where you stand and jump back to it, or warp to any address in any galaxy.
tp.notready: Your position can't be read right now
tp.addr.title: Go to an address
tp.addr.bad: Not a portal or galactic address (planet 0 to 6)
tp.note: Warps use the game's teleporter. Spots are kept in OpenSkies.bookmarks.json.
tp.corrected: No star there, warping to the nearest real one
tp.mapfix.warp: Not a real star here, warping to the nearest one
scout.subtitle: This system and the stars around it
scout.help: See what this system and its planets hold, then scan nearby regions for real systems. Filter them, sort by rarity, and warp to the one you want.
scout.here.none: Load a save to see this system.
scout.start: Pick a range and press Scan.
scout.planets.none: Planet details appear once the planets have loaded.
fx.subtitle: The game's own effects, tested and placed
fx.help: Pick an effect to test it in front of you; the menu steps aside while it plays. Place effects to decorate a base. Loop plays one again as soon as it ends; turn Loop off to play it on a timer instead. Placed effects come back each time you visit the system.
fx.note: Placed effects are kept by the menu, not in your save, so only you see them. Some effects only work attached to a ship or creature and show nothing on their own.
f.fx.move_left.tip: Acts on the placed effect picked in the Effects tab, or the newest one in this system.
f.fx.move_right.tip: Acts on the placed effect picked in the Effects tab, or the newest one in this system.
f.fx.move_fwd.tip: Acts on the placed effect picked in the Effects tab, or the newest one in this system.
f.fx.move_back.tip: Acts on the placed effect picked in the Effects tab, or the newest one in this system.
f.fx.move_up.tip: Acts on the placed effect picked in the Effects tab, or the newest one in this system.
f.fx.move_down.tip: Acts on the placed effect picked in the Effects tab, or the newest one in this system.
f.fx.turn_left.tip: Acts on the placed effect picked in the Effects tab, or the newest one in this system.
f.fx.turn_right.tip: Acts on the placed effect picked in the Effects tab, or the newest one in this system.
f.fx.tilt_up.tip: Acts on the placed effect picked in the Effects tab, or the newest one in this system.
f.fx.tilt_down.tip: Acts on the placed effect picked in the Effects tab, or the newest one in this system.
f.fx.roll_left.tip: Acts on the placed effect picked in the Effects tab, or the newest one in this system.
f.fx.roll_right.tip: Acts on the placed effect picked in the Effects tab, or the newest one in this system.
f.fx.to_me.tip: Acts on the placed effect picked in the Effects tab, or the newest one in this system.
f.fx.sky_toggle.tip: Turns the Effects tab's custom weather on or off.
fx.placedhere: Placed here ({0}). Pick one to move or turn it.
fx.edit.help: Every button is also a hotkey (Hotkeys page). Hotkeys work with the menu closed, so you can watch it move.
fx.sky.empty: Pick effects with Add to custom weather, then turn it on. Lightning, meteors, tornado parts, dust devils, fire and fireworks work well.
fx.sky.hint: These effects go off at random around you wherever you go. Real weather and Force storms below set the sky and hazard underneath; they are the same switches as World > Weather.
fx.sort.name: Name
fx.limit: Most placed effects shown at once
fx.limitwarn: Above 150, the game's own effects nearby (weapons, weather, explosions) can stop showing, since the game has room for 512 in total.
store.subtitle: Every container you own, at any distance
store.help: Find any item across your Exosuit, ships, freighter, storage containers and exocraft. Pick an item to send it to another container from anywhere, or sort a container the way the game does.
store.note: Moves use the game's own add and remove, so stack sizes follow each container. A save backup is made before the first change.
store.ingame: Load a save to see your containers.
store.missing: Storage is unavailable in this game version. Check the log.
store.sort.name: Name
scout.note: Systems come from the game's own galaxy generator, the same one portals use. Names show once a system is visited. Distances are by region.
gar.add.title: Add to Garage
gar.add.sub: New ship or Multi-Tool from a seed
gar.add.room: {0} of {1} slots used in this save
gar.add.note.ship: Paste a seed from the community with its ship type, or roll one. The new ship starts with a copy of your current ship's inventories and becomes your current ship.
gar.add.note.tool: Paste a seed with its Multi-Tool type, or roll one. The new tool starts with a copy of your held tool's inventory.
gar.name: Name
gar.subtitle: Your ships, Multi-Tools and freighter
gar.help: Pick something you own to change its model, seed, class or name. Paste a community seed to get that exact look. Models apply to whatever you are using now.
gar.note.stored: This ship is in storage. Changes show the next time you summon it.
gar.note.freighter: The freighter rebuilds in place after a model or seed change.
f.inv.slots_suit.tip: General, tech and cargo slots up to the game's limit.
f.inv.slots_tool.tip: Slots on the Multi-Tool you are holding.
f.inv.slots_ship.tip: General, tech and cargo slots on your current starship.
f.inv.slots_freighter.tip: General, tech and cargo slots on your freighter.
tabdesc.missions: Start, advance and finish missions, and find places on this planet.
f.fleet.max_stats.tip: Frigates count as fully upgraded on expeditions.
f.fleet.finish.tip: Running expeditions return on the next fleet update.
f.build.free.tip: Base parts and crafting cost nothing. Uses the game's own creative setting.
f.eco.free_shop.tip: Everything in shops, terminals and stations costs nothing. Uses the game's own creative setting.
f.eco.gifts.tip: Alien gifts and settlement requests always pass and take nothing.
mis.subtitle: Missions and signals
mis.help: Pick a mission to start it, or move an active one along. Signals find a place on the planet you are on, like a planetary chart.
mis.note: Story missions depend on each other. Starting or skipping them out of order can block story steps. Your save is backed up first.
sig.subtitle: Signal
sig.note: Marks the nearest one on this planet, the way a planetary chart does.
crew.subtitle: Frigates and companions
crew.help: Pick a frigate to change its class and stats, or a companion to change its genes and traits.
crew.note.frigate: Changes are saved with your next save. Your save is backed up first.
crew.note.pet: Size shows after you dismiss and summon the companion again.
f.move.noclip.tip: Fly through terrain, walls and structures on foot. Same keys as Fly Mode.
f.world.spawn_class.tip: Ships, Multi-Tools and freighters rolled from now on all get this class.
gar.nostats: No base stats on this store.
gar.custom.body: Change parts and colours live. Your save is backed up first.
gar.noparts: This one has no swappable parts.
gar.liv.note: This ship grows its parts from the seed. Pick the parts you want, find a seed that grows them, then use it.
gar.liv.note2: Every part comes from the seed too, including ones the customiser above can't change. Using a seed clears customiser parts.
gar.liv.notfound: No seed in {0} tries grows all of these. Try fewer picks.
gar.nopalette: No palette found for this item.
gar.nocustom: Customisation is off for this game version.
gar.note.suit: Your character rebuilds in place. Locked parts work too.
gar.note.vehicle: The exocraft updates the next time it is summoned.
f.world.tame.tip: Adopts the creature in the middle of your view. Any size, air and sea too.
f.world.tame_sight.tip: Adopts the next creature you look at, then turns off.
f.world.no_pirates.tip: No pirate ambushes, raids or freighter battles. Also stops bounty and swarm fights.
f.world.no_wanted.tip: Sentinels never raise your wanted level. Turning it on clears it.
f.ship.core_swap.tip: Pulse Drive, Hyperdrive and Launch Thruster can be removed, so the exclusive upgrades can replace them.
f.cust.exact_colours.tip: Custom Garage colours stay exact after a reload instead of snapping to the nearest palette colour.
gar.preview.label: Preview
gar.col.legacy: Uses old seed colours. Painting switches it to custom colours.
f.build.freestyle.tip: Place parts anywhere: outside bases, in the air, inside other parts, off bare ground.
f.build.upload_limit.tip: Bases up to 10000 parts can be uploaded instead of 3000.
f.tune.terrain.tip: Bigger or smaller terrain edits, and a longer beam.
f.build.all_parts.tip: Every part shows in the build menu, no blueprint needed. Parts work on planets, freighters, stations and corvettes, with no build limits.
f.ship.land_anywhere.tip: The ship lands wherever you ask, even when the game says it cannot. Landings may be rough.
